build_attention_pool: build a function that pools attention tensors with configurable spatial-temporal pooling and normalization
create_rel_pos_spatial: create decomposed spatial relative positional embeddings for attention matrices with height and width dimensions
create_rel_pos_temporal: create temporal relative positional embeddings for attention matrices along the time dimension
build_multi_scale_attention: build a multi-scale attention module with configurable pooling, relative positional embeddings, and conv-based or avg/max pooling modes
build_multi_scale_block: build a multi-scale transformer block combining multi-scale attention with MLP, residual connections, and drop path regularization
